title: Canonical scalar-forgetting comparison for the lci coinduction Hom model
statement: For schemes and morphisms [def-pc-scheme], let $T$ be a Koszul chart of [def-trf-lci-koszul-duality-data], with closed immersion $i:U\to P$ and quotient algebra $A=i_*\mathcal O_U$. Let $h$ be the proof data for additivity of ordinary coinduction $H_i$ and exactness of scalar restriction $s_i$ in [def-trf-polynomial-duality-presentation-data]. Define the canonical comparison $\chi_{T,h}:R H_i\,D(s_i)\xrightarrow{\sim}R\mathcal Hom_P(A[0],-)$, using [def-pur-derived-internal-hom, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Its representative formula is fixed as follows. For the functorial K-injective replacement $K\to I(K)$, apply $R H_i$ to the resolution map, then its standard computation on $I(K)$, then exact scalar restriction, then the ordinary evaluation-at-one-normalized comparison of [lem-sc-sheaf-coinduction-adjunction]. Finally insert the inverse projection $\mathcal Hom^\bullet(A[0],I(K))\to\mathcal Hom(A,I(K)^\bullet)$ onto source degree zero in [def-pur-hom-complex]. The ordinary comparison of [def-trf-lci-coinduction-ordinary-hom] is specified uniquely by the requirement that its value on a local algebra section $a$ is the evaluation counit applied to $a$ times the coinduction section. Its existence and the existence of the single-source natural comparison with its degreewise formula are included. For the underlying single-source projection the site may be any small ringed site with the usual sheafification and abelian module category, using additive postcomposition by the target maps. The induced comparison of [def-trf-lci-coinduction-complex-hom] from termwise coinduction with the single-source Hom complex is specified by requiring that each inverse component is this projection followed by the ordinary comparison inverse. Its existence is included, with precisely that determining formula. The projection commutes with differentials and is an isomorphism: every other source factor is zero. There exists a unique natural isomorphism with this formula after composing with the defining localization factorization of derived internal Hom. Define $\chi_{T,h}$ by that unique characterization. The comparison uses no choice of scalar, regular generators or coefficient frame.
